ItemID: NA; Title: Morning Phase; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I’m more interested in orchestral, vocal, or explicitly relaxing music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wish You Were Here; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not suggest the classical or polished vocal sound I’m seeking today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gentle on My Mind: Best of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Familiar, melodic country would fit alongside my interest in Golden and 747.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duets II; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets appeal to me given my interest in Stages and A Musical Affair.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Secret Life Of Walter Mitty Soundtrack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy soundtrack music, but this title alone gives me little reason to expect the Downton Abbey sound I like.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Peter, Paul and Mary; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Gentle vocal harmonies sound appealing, but I would choose the duets and relaxation music first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sunshine & Whiskey; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title suggests a livelier country mood than I want for this listening session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ultimate Hits: Rock And Roll Never Forgets; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A rock collection is less appealing right now than melodic vocals or calming instrumentals.
ItemID: NA; Title: An Open Sky - Soothing Guitar and Cello Music For Relaxation, Meditation and Well-Being -; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The soothing guitar and cello directly fit my recent interest in relaxing classical music.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection fits my taste.
